name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Accurately describes purpose: compute magic damage (resist-scaled) with a hit-chance roll and apply it (also awards XP via callee). No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Roll hit chance for a spell against a target, and if it lands, compute resist-scaled magic damage and apply it to that target (returning the damage dealt).
logic_summary: Reads target's job_id from runtime_char_array[target_idx] (offset +0x20). Fetches the spell effect entry via fd2_get_spell_effect_entry(spell_id): base_power = *(s16) at +0, chance_pct = *(byte) at +2. Looks up the per-job magic-resist scale factor data_fd2_battle_job_magic_resist_table[job_id-1] (1-based job_id; the function bulk-copies all 28 dwords to a stack scratch buffer first). damage = (s32)(base_power * resist) / 10. For status spells (spell_id 10..12) it first calls fd2_check_char_status_immunity(target_idx); if immune, returns 0. Then fd2_advance_rng_state(); if (rng % 100) >= chance_pct, returns 0 (miss/resisted). Otherwise returns fd2_apply_damage_and_award_xp(target_idx, damage).

params.name: target_idx
params.semantics: Index into runtime_char_array of the target/defender (NOT the caster). Used to read the defender's job_id for resist lookup, passed to the status-immunity check, and passed to the damage-apply callee.
params.reason: Accurate (defender index) and no address residue. Callers pass the per-target id (tid2 / target_id).

params.name: spell_id
params.semantics: Spell effect id (0x00..0x23). Indexes fd2_get_spell_effect_entry for base_power/chance_pct, and gates the status-immunity precheck for ids 10..12.

returns.semantics: Damage dealt to the target on a successful hit (return of fd2_apply_damage_and_award_xp); 0 on miss/resist or on status-spell immunity.

reads_globals: data_fd2_battle_job_magic_resist_table (0x51F96) -- 28 dwords, per-job magic resist/scale factor
notes: src comment block (battle.c ~L150-155) is concise, correct, ASCII -> kept. Ghidra plate is more detailed (zh) but not contradictory with the src understanding -> left unchanged. No logic concern: decompile's 'uVar3 = 0' reset and rng_or_chance/uVar3 aliasing are pure Ghidra EAX-tracking artifacts; disassembly (0x1C7ED CALL rng; MOV EDX,EAX; IDIV 0x64; CMP EDX,[ESP+0x70]; JGE ret0) confirms the src interpretation rng%100 >= chance_pct exactly. job_id offset +0x20, struct stride 0x50, table stride 4 with index job_id-1 all verified against disasm + types.h/btltab.c. No src edit needed beyond shard.
